v32_save.description: CYC4-005, single player or dedicated. Gives three diamonds, then saves. Expect SAVE worlds>=1 with dimensions listed (0 at least) and BUNDLE_END failed=0 tolerated<=1. The agent compares the player data file write time just before and just after.

v32_save_off.description: CYC4-005, dedicated server only (save-off exists there only). Turns saving off, saves, then turns it on. save-on fails with commands.save-on.alreadyOn when saving is already on, so BUNDLE_END failed=0 proves devtool save left saving off.
